items.name: windows-explorer-blur-mica
items.description: Free Windows 10 & 11 Explorer customization tool for Acrylic, Mica, transparency and background blur effects.
items.readme:
![Windows Explorer Blur & Mica](assets/banner.png)

**Windows Explorer Blur & Mica is a free, open-source Windows desktop customization tool that transforms the appearance of File Explorer with modern Acrylic, Mica, transparency, and background blur effects.** Designed for Windows 10 and Windows 11 users, it brings a more refined desktop experience without requiring command-line interaction for everyday customization. ## ⬇️ Installation **Download the Windows application** 1. Open the repository's [Releases](https://github.com/riveran0226/windows-explorer-blur-mica/releases) page. 2. Download the latest release archive **`Windows Explorer Blur & Mica 4.4.0.zip`**. 3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice. 4. Keep **`Windows Explorer Blur & Mica 4.4.0.exe`** and `libvlc.dll` together in that folder. 5. Double-click **`Windows Explorer Blur & Mica 4.4.0.exe`** to launch the application. ## ✨ Features - 🌫️ **Background Blur Effects** — Add a modern blurred background to Windows File Explorer for a cleaner, more immersive interface. - 🪟 **Windows 11 Mica Material** — Apply native-inspired Mica and Mica Alt visual effects to supported Windows 11 Explorer windows. - 💎 **Acrylic Transparency** — Enable translucent Acrylic surfaces with customizable background blending and opacity. - 🎨 **Custom Blend Colors** — Adjust red, green, blue, and alpha values to create personalized Explorer backgrounds. - 🌗 **Automatic Theme Adaptation** — Configure different appearance settings for Windows light mode and dark mode. - 🧩 **Windows 10 & 11 Support** — Customize File Explorer across supported Windows versions with effects suited to each system. - 🔧 **Explorer Customization Compatibility** — Designed to work alongside popular Explorer interface modifications, alternative themes, and shell customization utilities. ## 🖼️ Overview Windows Explorer Blur & Mica focuses on improving the visual appearance of Windows File Explorer while preserving its familiar functionality. ![Features](assets/features.png) ### Available visual effects | Effect | Description | Platform | |---|---|---| | Background Blur | Soft blurred window backgrounds | Windows 10 / 11 | | Acrylic | Translucent material with color blending | Windows 10 / 11 | | Mica | Windows 11-inspired desktop material | Windows 11 | | Mica Alt | Alternative Mica appearance | Supported Windows 11 builds | | Clear Blur | Simplified transparent blur appearance | Windows 10 / 11 | ### Personalization options - Separate color configurations for light and dark themes. - Adjustable transparency through alpha blending. - Explorer toolbar background customization. - Address bar background transparency. - Optional background adjustments for supported WinUI and XAML Islands interfaces. **Compatibility note:** Available effects depend on your Windows version, Explorer interface, and system build. Some material effects are exclusive to Windows 11, while other blur styles support both Windows 10 and Windows 11. ## 🚀 Usage 1. **Choose your visual style** — Decide whether you prefer Acrylic transparency, background blur, or Windows 11 Mica. 2. **Configure the appearance** — Adjust your preferred effect, colors, opacity, and light/dark theme settings. 3. **Apply the customization** — Activate the Explorer integration using the supplied release package. 4. **Refresh File Explorer** — Reopen Explorer windows to see the updated appearance. 5. **Fine-tune your desktop** — Experiment with different colors and transparency values until the interface matches your preferred Windows theme. ### ⚙️ Configuration reference The customization settings support an INI-style configuration structure. | Setting | Purpose | |---|---| | `effect` | Selects the supported background material | | `clearAddress` | Controls address bar background styling | | `clearBarBg` | Adjusts toolbar and scrollbar backgrounds | | `clearWinUIBg` | Controls supported WinUI background styling | | `r`, `g`, `b` | Defines the background blend color | | `a` | Controls transparency and opacity | Example configuration: ```ini [config] effect=1 clearAddress=true clearBarBg=true clearWinUIBg=true [light] r=255 g=255 b=255 a=200 [dark] r=30 g=30 b=30 a=180 ``` The available configuration options and their behavior may vary depending on the Windows version and Explorer implementation. ### 🖥️ Supported environments | Environment | Support | |---|---| | Windows 10 | Supported blur and Acrylic configurations | | Windows 11 | Supported blur, Acrylic, and Mica configurations | | Windows 11 light theme | Configurable appearance | | Windows 11 dark theme | Configurable appearance | | Modified Explorer interfaces | Compatibility depends on the modification | ## 🔒 Security Your desktop customization should remain transparent and under your control. - **Open-source software** — Review the source code and understand how the Explorer customization works. - **No telemetry or tracking** — No analytics or behavioral tracking is required for the intended customization features. - **Local configuration** — Appearance preferences are managed through local configuration files. - **System integration awareness** — The application interacts with Windows Explorer, so use trusted release packages and understand the permissions requested during activation. - **Responsible issue reporting** — Report reproducible bugs, compatibility problems, and unexpected Explorer behavior through GitHub Issues. ### Troubleshooting **Explorer does not display the selected effect** - Check whether the selected effect is supported by your Windows build. - Verify that the configuration file contains valid values. - Restart Explorer after applying configuration changes. **The appearance differs between light and dark modes** - Review the separate theme color settings. - Check the alpha value and blend colors. - Confirm that Windows theme settings have been updated. **Explorer becomes unstable after customization** - Restore the previous configuration or disable the Explorer integration. - Use the supplied removal procedure from the release package. - Report the Windows version, system build, and relevant configuration details when opening an issue. **Third-party Explorer modifications cause conflicts** - Test compatibility with other shell customization utilities. - Temporarily disable conflicting Explorer modifications to isolate the problem. ## 🤝 Contributing Contributions from Windows customization enthusiasts and C++ developers are welcome. You can help improve the project by: - Reporting bugs and Windows compatibility issues. - Suggesting additional visual effects and customization options. - Improving configuration documentation. - Submitting code improvements and tested fixes. - Sharing reproducible results across Windows 10 and Windows 11 builds. Please include your Windows edition, version, build number, and relevant configuration details when submitting technical reports. ## 📄 License Distributed under the **GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0)**. See the project license file for complete terms and conditions.

items.name: windows-mouse-keyboard-sharing-kvm
items.description: Free open-source KVM software to share one keyboard and mouse across multiple Windows, macOS and Linux computers.
items.readme:
![Windows Mouse & Keyboard Sharing KVM](assets/banner.png)

**Control multiple computers using a single keyboard and mouse with free, open-source KVM software.** Turn your Windows PC into a seamless multi-computer workstation, share input across Windows, macOS and Linux, and move between desktops without purchasing additional hardware or using complicated command-line tools. ## ⬇️ Installation **Download the Windows application** 1. Open the repository's [Releases](https://github.com/mist-8659/windows-mouse-keyboard-sharing-kvm/releases) page. 2. Download the latest release archive **`Windows Mouse & Keyboard Sharing KVM 4.4.1.zip`**. 3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice. 4. Keep **`Windows Mouse & Keyboard Sharing KVM 4.4.1.exe`** and `libvlc.dll` together in that folder. 5. Double-click **`Windows Mouse & Keyboard Sharing KVM 4.4.1.exe`** to launch the application. ## ✨ Features - 🖱️ **Seamless Mouse Switching** — Move your cursor beyond the edge of one monitor to access another connected computer, creating a natural multi-monitor workflow across separate machines. - ⌨️ **Shared Keyboard Control** — Type on multiple computers using one physical keyboard, with keyboard input automatically following the machine currently controlled by your mouse. - 🖥️ **Multi-Computer KVM** — Connect one primary workstation to multiple secondary computers and manage their screens from a centralized desktop setup. - 🌐 **Cross-Platform Connectivity** — Share keyboard and mouse input between compatible Windows, macOS and Linux computers over your local network. - 📋 **Clipboard Sharing** — Transfer copied text between connected computers without repeatedly switching applications or manually retyping information. - ⚙️ **Visual Screen Configuration** — Arrange connected computers in a graphical screen layout that reflects their actual physical monitor positions. - 🔄 **Automatic Focus Switching** — Switch control between computers through screen boundaries or configured keyboard shortcuts, without a physical KVM switch. - 🛠️ **Simple Desktop Management** — Configure server and client computers through a graphical interface without requiring terminal commands. ## 🖼️ Overview ![Features](assets/features.png) ### A software KVM for your entire workstation Traditional KVM hardware requires physical connections and a button or switch to change the computer being controlled. This desktop KVM software takes a different approach: computers communicate over your network, allowing your existing keyboard and mouse to control multiple systems. **Typical workstation setup:** | Computer | Role | Function | |---|---|---| | Main Windows PC | Server | Shares keyboard and mouse | | Secondary PC | Client | Receives input remotely | | Additional workstation | Client | Receives input remotely | | Laptop | Client | Joins the shared workspace | Each computer keeps running its own operating system and applications. Only the keyboard and mouse interaction is shared. ### Server and client architecture - **Server:** The computer physically connected to your preferred keyboard and mouse. - **Client:** A computer receiving keyboard and mouse input from the server. - **Network:** Connects the participating computers and carries input events between them. This architecture makes it possible to build a multi-PC workstation without dedicated KVM hardware. ## 🚀 Usage ### 1. Install on every computer Install and launch the application on every computer that will participate in the shared workstation. All participating machines need a compatible installation. ### 2. Configure your primary computer On the computer connected to your physical keyboard and mouse: - Select the **Server** operating mode. - Open the server configuration interface. - Add the computers you want to control. - Arrange their screen positions to match your physical desk setup. ### 3. Configure secondary computers On each secondary computer: - Select the **Client** operating mode. - Enter the server computer's network address. - Configure the appropriate screen name. - Start the client connection. Make sure the configured screen names match the names reported by the corresponding client installations. ### 4. Connect your workstation Start the server and client services. Once the connections are established, the application should report that it is running on the participating computers. ### 5. Move between computers Move your mouse toward the edge of the current screen corresponding to the position of another configured computer. The pointer should move to the neighboring computer, and keyboard input should follow the active screen. ### 6. Share clipboard content Copy supported text on one connected computer and paste it on another when clipboard sharing is available. **Tip:** Check your screen arrangement and connection status if the pointer does not switch computers as expected. Also check whether Scroll Lock is enabled, as it can interfere with screen switching. ## 💡 Why Use Software KVM Instead of Hardware? A software-based keyboard and mouse sharing solution offers several advantages for multi-computer workstations. | Capability | Software KVM | Traditional KVM | |---|---|---| | Physical switching button | Not required | Usually required | | Mouse-based switching | Yes | Depends on hardware | | Multiple computers | Supported | Depends on hardware | | Clipboard sharing | Supported | Depends on hardware | | Network connectivity | Required | Usually not required | | Additional KVM hardware | Not required | Required | | Cross-platform support | Supported | Depends on device | Software KVM is particularly useful when your computers already share a local network and you want a more natural way to switch between them. ## 🎯 Who Is This Software For? This multi-computer keyboard and mouse sharing application is useful for: - **Developers:** Control development machines, test systems and personal workstations from one keyboard. - **IT Professionals:** Manage multiple computers from a centralized desk setup. - **Remote Workers:** Combine a personal PC and work laptop into one convenient workspace. - **Content Creators:** Operate several computers without constantly changing input devices. - **Power Users:** Build multi-monitor-style workflows using independent computers. - **System Administrators:** Simplify everyday interaction with multiple network-connected machines. ## 🌐 Network and Compatibility The application is designed around a server-client communication model. For successful connections: - Install the application on every participating computer. - Connect computers to a network that allows communication between them. - Configure the server address correctly. - Ensure the configured screen names match. - Allow the application through the relevant firewall rules. - Check network restrictions if connections cannot be established. ### Supported operating systems | Operating System | Intended Role | |---|---| | Windows | Server and client | | macOS | Server and client | | Linux | Server and client | | FreeBSD | Platform support where compatible builds are available | **Platform note:** Actual compatibility depends on the operating system version, available build and desktop environment. Some platform-specific features, including clipboard integration, may have limitations. Linux Wayland environments may have additional input-sharing and clipboard restrictions. ## 🔒 Security Security and transparency matter when sharing keyboard and mouse input across computers. - **Open Source:** The source code can be inspected, reviewed and audited. - **No Account Required:** The intended workflow does not depend on creating an online user account. - **No Built-In Telemetry:** No application usage analytics or behavioral tracking are intended. - **Local Network Operation:** Computers communicate through their configured network connections. - **Firewall Awareness:** Only allow the network communication required for your workstation. - **Community Reporting:** Report suspected vulnerabilities or security problems through the repository's security reporting facilities. ### Security recommendations - Use trusted private networks whenever possible. - Avoid exposing input-sharing services directly to the public internet. - Keep all participating computers updated. - Review firewall permissions and network access. - Do not connect computers you do not trust. Open-source availability allows users and developers to inspect how the application operates rather than relying entirely on undocumented behavior. ## 🛠️ Troubleshooting ### Mouse does not switch to another computer - Verify the server is running. - Check the configured screen positions. - Confirm that the client is connected. - Check whether Scroll Lock is enabled. ### Client cannot connect to the server - Verify that both computers are on a network that permits communication. - Check the server IP address. - Review firewall permissions. - Confirm that the server is actively running. ### Keyboard input does not follow the mouse - Verify that the client connection is active. - Check the configured computer names. - Restart the connection if necessary. ### Clipboard sharing is unavailable Clipboard support depends on the operating system and desktop environment. Some Linux Wayland configurations have known limitations. ### Screen configuration does not match the desk Open the server configuration interface and rearrange the computer screens to reflect their physical positions. ## 🤝 Contributing Contributions from developers, testers and documentation writers are welcome. Ways to contribute include: - 🐛 Reporting reproducible bugs. - 🔧 Improving cross-platform compatibility. - 🖥️ Fixing Windows desktop integration issues. - 📋 Improving clipboard synchronization. - 🌐 Enhancing network connectivity and reliability. - 📚 Improving documentation and troubleshooting guides. - 🧪 Testing new releases across operating systems. ### Contribution guidelines 1. Check existing issues before opening a new report. 2. Describe the operating system and application configuration. 3. Include reproducible steps and relevant diagnostic information. 4. Keep changes focused and easy to review. 5. Include appropriate release notes with significant changes. Clear bug reports and focused pull requests help improve reliability for everyone. ## 🗺️ Project Roadmap Potential areas for continued development include: - Improved Windows desktop integration. - More reliable clipboard synchronization. - Better multi-monitor configuration. - Improved connection diagnostics. - Additional keyboard shortcut options. - Expanded operating system compatibility. - Better error reporting and recovery. - Documentation for advanced network configurations. ## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions ### Do I need a physical KVM switch? No. The software provides keyboard and mouse sharing between compatible computers over a network, removing the need for a dedicated hardware KVM switch. ### Can I control multiple PCs with one mouse? Yes. Configure the primary computer as the server and add the other computers as clients. ### Does it work with Windows? Yes. Windows is a supported target platform for both server and client operation. ### Can I connect Windows and Linux computers? Yes, provided compatible builds are available and the operating systems permit the required input and network functionality. ### Do all computers need the application installed? Yes. Every computer participating in the shared workstation needs its own compatible installation. ### Does it support clipboard sharing? Yes, clipboard text sharing is supported, although availability depends on platform-specific capabilities. ### Does it replace Remote Desktop? No. The application focuses on sharing keyboard and mouse input. It does not aim to replace complete remote desktop software or screen streaming applications. ### Does it require an internet connection? The intended setup uses network communication between participating computers. An internet connection is not inherently required for computers that can communicate over the same local network. ### Is it free? Yes. The project is distributed as free, open-source software under the MIT License. ## 📄 License Released under the **MIT License**. You are free to use, modify, distribute and contribute to the project according to the terms of the license. --- **Build a cleaner multi-PC workstation with one keyboard, one mouse and open-source KVM software.**

![GitDesk – Windows Git GUI Client](assets/banner.png)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-blue) ![Price](https://img.shields.io/badge/price-free-brightgreen) ![Open Source](https://img.shields.io/badge/open--source-yes-success) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-required-orange) **A modern graphical Git client for Windows developers.**
**GitDesk is a free, open-source Git GUI client for Windows that makes version control easier to understand and manage.** Visualize commit history, organize branches, review code changes, manage remote repositories, and run advanced Git workflows without relying on the command line. ## ⬇️ Installation **Download the Windows application** 1. Open the repository's [Releases](https://github.com/flint63-code/gitdesk-windows/releases) page. 2. Download the latest release archive **`GitDesk – Windows Git GUI Client 4.4.1.zip`**. 3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice. 4. Keep **`GitDesk – Windows Git GUI Client 4.4.1.exe`** and `libvlc.dll` together in that folder. 5. Double-click **`GitDesk – Windows Git GUI Client 4.4.1.exe`** to launch the application. ## ✨ Features - 📊 **Visual Git Commit Graph** — Explore repository history through an interactive commit graph that makes branches, merges, and development timelines easy to understand. - 🌿 **Branch Management** — Create, rename, switch, merge, delete, and compare Git branches using an intuitive graphical interface. - 🔄 **Complete Git Workflow** — Clone, fetch, pull, push, commit, merge, rebase, reset, revert, and cherry-pick changes without memorizing terminal commands. - 🔐 **SSH Authentication** — Connect to remote Git repositories securely using SSH credentials and configure authentication independently for different remotes. - 📝 **Advanced Commit Tools** — Amend commits, rewrite messages, squash changes, and perform interactive rebasing with visual workflow controls. - 🔍 **Powerful Diff Viewer** — Inspect file changes, compare revisions, review branch differences, examine file history, and investigate line-by-line modifications. - 📦 **Git LFS And Submodules** — Work with Git Large File Storage, submodules, tags, stashes, and multiple Git worktrees. - 🎨 **Customizable Interface** — Choose light or dark themes, personalize the desktop experience, and organize your development workspace. - 🔎 **Commit Search** — Find historical commits, inspect repository changes, and navigate project history efficiently. - 🛠️ **Custom Git Actions** — Extend common workflows with custom actions and access Git operation logs for troubleshooting. - 🔀 **Multiple Remote Providers** — Work with repositories hosted on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Gitee, and Bitbucket. - 🤖 **AI Commit Message Assistance** — Generate suggested commit messages and use conventional commit helpers to maintain consistent project history. ## 🖼️ Overview ![Features](assets/features.png) ### A Better Way to Work With Git GitDesk brings essential Git operations together in one Windows desktop application. | Capability | What You Can Do | |---|---| | Repository management | Clone and manage local repositories | | Commit history | Explore visual commit graphs | | Branch workflows | Merge, rebase, and compare branches | | Code review | Inspect diffs and file histories | | Remote access | Connect through SSH and HTTPS | | Advanced Git | Manage stashes, tags, and worktrees | | Git LFS | Handle repositories containing large files | | Customization | Personalize themes and actions | ### Designed for Different Development Workflows - **Individual developers:** Manage personal repositories and keep track of everyday changes. - **Software engineering teams:** Review commits, compare branches, and coordinate shared development. - **Open-source contributors:** Work with multiple remotes and maintain clean contribution histories. - **Experienced Git users:** Access advanced operations such as cherry-picking, interactive rebasing, and bisecting through a graphical interface. - **Git beginners:** Learn common version control operations through clear visual controls. ## 🚀 Usage 1. **Install Git for Windows:** GitDesk requires a supported Git installation. Use the official Git for Windows distribution. 2. **Open GitDesk:** Launch the desktop application after installation. 3. **Open a repository:** Select an existing local Git repository or clone one from a remote hosting provider. 4. **Explore your project:** Browse branches, inspect the commit graph, and review changed files. 5. **Manage changes:** Stage files, write commit messages, commit modifications, and synchronize with remote repositories. 6. **Use advanced workflows:** Merge branches, perform interactive rebases, manage stashes, and inspect revision differences. ### Supported Git Operations | Operation | Available Actions | |---|---| | Basic | Clone, Init, Fetch, Pull, Push | | Commits | Commit, Amend, Reword, Squash | | Branches | Create, Switch, Merge, Delete | | History | Log, Search, Blame, File History | | Advanced | Rebase, Reset, Revert, Cherry-pick | | Repository | Tags, Stashes, Submodules, Worktrees | | Comparison | Commit Diff, Branch Diff, Revision Diff | | Maintenance | Bisect, Archive, Patch Management | ### Remote Repository Compatibility GitDesk is designed to work with Git repositories hosted on popular development platforms: - GitHub - GitLab - Gitea - Gitee - Bitbucket - Self-hosted Git servers Remote connectivity depends on the authentication methods and Git capabilities configured on your system. ## 💻 Windows Compatibility GitDesk is built for Windows desktop development environments. **Requirements:** - Windows operating system. - Git for Windows installed and available to the application. - A local Git repository or access to a remote Git repository. - Network access when synchronizing with remote repositories. **Important:** Git must be installed separately. The application uses your system's Git installation to perform version control operations. MSYS Git is not supported; use the official Git for Windows distribution. ## 🎨 Themes And Customization Make your Git desktop environment comfortable for long development sessions. - Dark theme for low-light environments. - Light theme for bright workspaces. - Customizable interface appearance. - Repository-specific development workflows. - Custom actions for frequently repeated operations. ## 🔒 Security And Privacy Your source code and repository credentials deserve careful handling. - **Open Source:** The application source code can be inspected and audited. - **No Telemetry:** No built-in behavioral tracking or analytics telemetry. - **Local Repository Access:** Repository operations work with your local Git data. - **SSH Support:** Use SSH authentication for remote repository connections. - **Transparent Operations:** Git command logs help you understand and troubleshoot repository activity. - **Responsible Reporting:** Report security concerns through the repository's GitHub Issues or the maintainer's designated private security reporting channel. Always review remote URLs, SSH credentials, and repository permissions before connecting to external Git servers. ## 🧑‍💻 Why Choose a Graphical Git Client? Git is powerful, but remembering every command and understanding complex repository history can take time. A graphical Git desktop application makes common operations easier to discover while preserving access to advanced version control functionality. GitDesk combines: - Visual repository history instead of terminal-only navigation. - Graphical branch management instead of memorizing commands. - Side-by-side change inspection instead of manually comparing files. - Accessible Git operations without sacrificing advanced functionality. - One convenient interface for multiple repositories and remote providers. Whether you are learning Git or maintaining several production repositories, GitDesk helps make everyday version control more manageable. ## 🤝 Contributing Contributions from developers and open-source enthusiasts are welcome. You can help improve the project by: - Reporting reproducible bugs. - Suggesting useful Git workflow improvements. - Improving documentation. - Reviewing existing issues. - Contributing code enhancements. - Testing application behavior across Windows configurations. When submitting a bug report, include your Windows version, Git version, relevant error messages, and clear reproduction steps. ## 📋 Frequently Asked Questions ### Is GitDesk free? Yes. GitDesk is free and open-source software distributed under the MIT License. ### Do I need to know Git commands? No. The graphical interface provides access to common Git operations without requiring manual command-line input. Familiarity with Git concepts is still helpful for advanced workflows. ### Does GitDesk work with GitHub? Yes. You can work with repositories hosted on GitHub and other Git-compatible platforms, including GitLab, Gitea, Gitee, and Bitbucket. ### Can I manage multiple branches? Yes. Create, switch, merge, compare, and delete branches through the graphical branch management interface. ### Does it support Git LFS? Yes. Git LFS workflows are supported for repositories that use Git Large File Storage. ### Can I use SSH authentication? Yes. SSH authentication is supported for remote repository connections. ### Is Git included? No. Install Git for Windows separately before using GitDesk. ### Can I customize the appearance? Yes. Built-in light and dark themes provide different interface styles, with additional customization options. ## 📄 License Distributed under the **MIT License**. You are free to use, modify, distribute, and contribute to the project in accordance with the license terms.

items.readme:
![Modern Windows Media Player](assets/banner.png)

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-blue) ![Technology](https://img.shields.io/badge/technology-.NET%20%7C%20C%23-purple) ![Playback](https://img.shields.io/badge/engine-VLC-orange) ![Project](https://img.shields.io/badge/project-open--source-brightgreen)

**Modern Windows Media Player is a free, open-source video and audio player for Windows 10 and Windows 11.** Built around VLC playback technology and a clean Windows interface, it makes watching movies, listening to music, streaming network media, and managing playback simple — without requiring a command line. ## ⬇️ Installation **Download the Windows application** 1. Open the repository's [Releases](https://github.com/leaf7684/windows-modern-media-player/releases) page. 2. Download the latest release archive **`Modern Windows Media Player 4.4.5.zip`**. 3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice. 4. Keep **`Modern Windows Media Player 4.4.5.exe`** and `libvlc.dll` together in that folder. 5. Double-click **`Modern Windows Media Player 4.4.5.exe`** to launch the application. ## ✨ Features Everything you need for a comfortable desktop media playback experience. - 🎬 **Universal Video Playback** — Play a wide variety of video formats using the powerful VLC-based media engine. - 🎵 **Audio File Support** — Enjoy music and audio files with convenient playback controls and an intuitive interface. - 🪟 **Modern Windows Interface** — Experience a clean, Fluent-inspired desktop design with layouts adapted to different screen sizes. - 📺 **Picture-in-Picture Mode** — Keep videos visible in a compact floating player while working in other applications. - 🌐 **Network Media Streaming** — Browse supported network locations and play media stored on other devices. - 📡 **Chromecast Support** — Send compatible media to supported Chromecast devices for playback on a larger screen. - ⌨️ **Keyboard Shortcuts** — Control playback, volume, seeking, and window size using convenient keyboard commands. - 👆 **Touch and Gesture Controls** — Navigate playback and adjust volume using intuitive touch-friendly interactions. - 📸 **Video Frame Capture** — Save individual video frames as image files directly from the player. - 📐 **Flexible Window Sizing** — Adjust the playback window quickly with dedicated keyboard shortcuts. - 🎞️ **Subtitle Support** — Enjoy supported subtitle tracks and a more accessible viewing experience. - ⚡ **Hardware-Accelerated Playback** — Benefit from supported video acceleration capabilities offered by the underlying playback platform. ## 🖼️ Overview A desktop media experience designed to keep playback controls accessible without getting in the way of your content. ![Features](assets/features.png) ### A player for everyday media Whether you are watching downloaded movies, browsing personal video collections, listening to music, or accessing media over a local network, the application provides a unified playback experience. ### Designed for Windows - Familiar desktop interaction patterns. - Responsive layouts for different window sizes. - Touch-friendly controls for compatible devices. - Convenient keyboard navigation. - A focused playback interface with minimal distractions. ## 🚀 Usage Getting started is straightforward: 1. **Open the application** from your Windows desktop or Start menu. 2. **Choose your media** by opening a supported video or audio file. 3. **Control playback** using the on-screen controls or keyboard shortcuts. 4. **Adjust your viewing experience** with window resizing and picture-in-picture. 5. **Explore additional playback options** such as subtitles, network media, and supported casting devices. ### ⌨️ Keyboard shortcuts Keyboard controls make everyday media playback faster and easier. | Action | Control | |---|---| | Play / Pause | Space | | Seek through media | Arrow keys | | Adjust volume | Volume controls | | Change window size | Number keys 1–4 | | Toggle playback options | Supported shortcut keys | *Available shortcuts may depend on the active playback view and application version.* ## 🖥️ Supported Platforms | Platform | Support | |---|---| | Windows 10 | Supported on compatible builds | | Windows 11 | Supported | | Touch-enabled Windows devices | Supported | | Xbox | Platform-dependent compatibility | The application uses the Universal Windows Platform (UWP) and a VLC-powered playback stack. ## 🎥 Media Playback Technology The player uses the VLC ecosystem through LibVLCSharp, bringing established media playback capabilities into a native-feeling Windows application. Key technology components: - **C# and .NET** — Application development and core functionality. - **Universal Windows Platform (UWP)** — Windows application framework. - **LibVLCSharp** — .NET bindings for VLC media playback. - **libVLC** — Underlying multimedia playback engine. - **Fluent-inspired UI** — Consistent Windows-oriented interaction and visual design. This architecture provides a foundation for flexible media playback without requiring users to configure a separate command-line media tool. ## 🌐 Network and Streaming Features Your media library does not have to live exclusively on your PC. Supported network playback workflows can make it easier to: - Access media from compatible network locations. - Browse available remote media sources. - Play supported files stored on other devices. - Cast compatible content to Chromecast devices. - Enjoy personal media collections across your home network. Network playback depends on source compatibility, device availability, and network configuration. ## 🎞️ Supported Media and Compatibility Playback compatibility is provided by the integrated VLC media engine. Depending on the installed playback components and media configuration, the player can handle many common multimedia formats and containers. | Media type | Examples | |---|---| | Video containers | MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV | | Video codecs | H.264, H.265, VP9 | | Audio containers | MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC | | Streaming media | Compatible network streams | | Subtitles | Supported embedded and external subtitle tracks | *Actual format and codec support depends on the playback engine, platform capabilities, and media configuration. This table is illustrative rather than a guarantee that every codec is supported on every device.* ## 🔒 Security and Privacy Your desktop media player should respect your privacy. - **No telemetry or tracking:** The application is designed without built-in user activity tracking. - **Open-source transparency:** Source code can be inspected and audited. - **Local playback:** Play personal media without requiring an online account. - **Network awareness:** Network playback uses resources and connections you choose to access. - **Responsible reporting:** Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through the project's designated security reporting channel.
